name: unknown-architecture-style
description: Review requested without a declared architecture style.
input: Review the changes in the order module. There is no plan artifact and the architecture style was not stated.
expected_behavior: Does not assume MVC or hexagonal.
Stops and asks which style applies, or asks for the plan artifact.
Records architecture conformance as not-checked instead of pass.
Lists the not-checked item under blocked validations.
Does not issue an approved verdict based on an assumed style.
